pages.text: Overwrites characters of a text with another text.$(br2)The length of the text stays the same. Characters of $(1)insert$() that would make it longer are dropped. A start behind the end of the text raises INVALID_ARGUMENT.
$(li)$(1)text$() STRING: the text$(li)$(1)start$() INTEGER: the position where overwriting begins$(li)$(1)insert$() STRING: the new characters$(li)result $(1)result$() STRING: the changed text
$(1)CALL c0de/strings/REPLACE$(br)  PARAMETER text "Hello Alex" ;$(br)  PARAMETER start 6 ;$(br)  PARAMETER insert "Stev" ;$(br)  RESULT result greeting$()
